gradle-wrapper.jar — UNVERIFIED PLACEHOLDER
=============================================

This file is intentionally NOT a real Gradle wrapper JAR. This machine has no
Gradle / Android SDK installed, so a legitimate `gradle-wrapper.jar` binary
cannot be generated here.

What IS provided and correct:
  - gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties        (Gradle 8.9 distribution URL)
  - gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties.template (same content, for Studio)
  - gradlew / gradlew.bat                            (standard Gradle 8.9 scripts)

To materialise a real wrapper JAR (requires a Gradle install, e.g. via Android
Studio or a standalone Gradle 8.9 on PATH):

    gradle wrapper --gradle-version 8.9

Android Studio can also "generate wrapper" / auto-fix on first Sync.

Per CONTRACT §2.5, the wrapper JAR is a binary that must be produced by Gradle,
so its validity is explicitly UNVERIFIED here. Reviewer must not treat the
missing JAR as a compile pass.
